# Chaitanya Media

Official website: https://chaitanya-media.vercel.app/en/

Chaitanya Media is a Pune-based digital marketing and campaign support agency for Indian businesses, local brands, event teams, schools, real estate teams, jewellery and retail brands, and political campaigns.

Primary services:
- Digital marketing strategy and customized advertising
- Social media marketing, content, reels, and campaign creatives
- Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, web designing, and web development
- Bulk SMS, email marketing, WhatsApp campaign support, IVR, missed-call alerts, and voice call campaigns
- Election management, booth survey and voter analysis, election software support, voter slip and booth kit support, LED van campaigns, print media, outdoor design, and campaign material supply
- Real estate marketing, jewellery branding, event and wedding digital invitations, school admission campaigns, retail and local business marketing

Service area: Pune, Shewalewadi, Hadapsar, Manjri, Maharashtra, and India.

Important accuracy note:
Chaitanya Media plans and executes marketing and campaign support. The website should not be interpreted as promising guaranteed election wins, guaranteed rankings, guaranteed reach, or guaranteed revenue. Performance depends on audience, message, timing, budget, competition, follow-up, platform rules, and applicable election or advertising regulations.
